display.purpose: Story headlines and section titles; uppercase Big Shoulders 900 at opsz 72. Menu title runs up to clamp(4.4rem, 15vw, 11rem); mobile story headlines clamp(3.6rem, 15vw, 6rem).

headline.purpose: Menu category headings, each led by a menu-red star.

title.purpose: Product names and dialog titles (2.35 to 3.4rem); 1.5 to 1.6rem for cart lines and legends.

body.purpose: Running copy in Barlow; descriptions cap at 46 to 52ch, long-form at 1.12rem/1.7 and 64ch.

label.purpose: Barlow Condensed uppercase for buttons, chips, taglines, list names, field labels; 0.04 to 0.14em tracking.

price.purpose: Display figures with tabular lining numerals; currency in condensed bold at 0.42em, cents at 0.5em raised.

shadows.name: contact-stage
shadows.purpose: Floor shadow under the story burger; narrows and fades when the burger explodes.

shadows.name: contact-menu
shadows.purpose: Contact shadow under menu renders; narrows on hover as the render lifts.

shadows.name: render-drop
shadows.purpose: Floating ingredient renders on scene fields.

shadows.name: render-drop-sheet
shadows.purpose: Hero render inside the product sheet.

shadows.name: floating-bar
shadows.purpose: Toast and mobile cart bar (0.6 alpha).

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: All entrances: dialogs, drawer, nav overlay, toasts, render hovers, burger explode in the sheet.

motion.name: ease-in-quart
motion.purpose: Exits, at roughly half the entrance duration (0.26s dialogs, 0.38s nav overlay).

motion.name: dialog-enter
motion.value: 0.5s ease-out-expo via @starting-style; mobile translateY(12%), desktop sheet translateY(24px) scale(0.98), desktop drawer translateX(16%)

motion.name: nav-reveal
motion.value: clip-path circle(0% to 150%) from the menu button, 0.75s ease-out-expo; links rise from 105% with 60ms stagger after 160ms

motion.name: story-scrub
motion.value: GSAP ScrollTrigger pin, scrub 0.7, +640vh desktop / +560vh mobile; field wipes power2.inOut, copy out power2.in, copy in power3.out

motion.name: bob
motion.value: ease-in-out infinite, 6 to 8s, -12 to -18px with slight rotation
motion.purpose: Idle float for the story burger and ingredients.

motion.name: layer-stagger
motion.purpose: Burger stack explode and restack outside the story.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all durations 0.001ms; cinematic story swapped for a static stacked story

narrative.overview:
Downtown Burger's system is its own printed menu and badge, pushed to signage saturation. Five flat scene fields (red, burnt orange, diner green, plum, teal) carry the story; cream and paper carry the commerce. Everything that sells is set in heavy condensed skyline lettering, and everything that is read is set in a plain grotesque. The burger itself, as a layered 3D render, is the hero of every dark surface; type and rules frame it, never compete with it.

The world borrows the menu's furniture literally: double-line frames, dotted price leaders, ruled grids between products, five-point stars as the only ornament, and the circular skyline badge. Density alternates hard: the story is one object on one colour per viewport, the menu is a ruled, generous paper sheet. Motion is scroll-scrubbed and physical in the story, and short and interruptible everywhere else.

Confirmed rejection, from the direction contract: the split hero with a photo on one side and a card grid below.
keyCharacteristics: One saturated scene colour per viewport on story surfaces; cream or paper on commerce surfaces.
Uppercase heavy condensed display type, tightly leaded, at poster scale.
Menu furniture as structure: double rules, dotted leaders, 2px ink rules over hairline dividers.
Rendered burgers and ingredients float over soft contact shadows; no photography.
Pills for every control; large soft corners for sheets and frames.
Native dialogs animated with `@starting-style`; pinned GSAP story with a static reduced-motion twin.

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: A viewport shows one scene colour at a time. Fields wipe over one another; they never sit side by side as tiles.

rules.name: The Action Contrast Rule
rules.body: On colour or ink, the primary action is a mustard pill with ink text. On cream or paper, it is an ink pill that turns menu red on hover. The final send-the-order button alone is solid menu red.

rules.name: The Grain Rule
rules.body: Cream commerce surfaces (body, location, product sheet, cart drawer) carry the faint fractal-noise print grain. Scene fields and ink surfaces stay flat.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Display face for names, headings and totals; condensed for anything a person taps or scans. Barlow body never goes uppercase.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every price, count and total uses tabular lining numerals.

rules.name: The Food Floats Rule
rules.body: Shadows describe the food sitting in space. Cards, buttons and rules never cast shadows.

dos: Do give each story or overlay surface exactly one scene field, with ink and on-dark text only.
Do set every heading, name and total in uppercase Big Shoulders 900 at opsz 72 with 0.86 line height.
Do use the menu's own furniture (double rule, double frame, ruled grid, dotted leader) for structure before reaching for a container.
Do keep controls as pills of at least 44px with condensed uppercase labels.
Do label generated imagery as illustrative, give layered renders true ingredient labels, and keep decorative renders `alt=""`.
Do enter with out-expo (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`) and leave faster with in-quart (`cubic-bezier(0.5, 0, 0.75, 0)`), and give every scrubbed or looping motion a reduced-motion state.
Do keep supporting text on any scene field at 4.5:1 or above; switch from on-dark-mute to on-dark wherever the field is too light to hold it.
donts: Don't build a split hero with a photo on one side and a card grid below.
Don't put product cards on tinted boxes or shadows; products live in ruled cells.
Don't add ornaments beyond the five-point star and the badge, and draw the star as SVG, not as a text glyph.
Don't use mustard as a fill on cream surfaces for primary commerce; there the action is ink.
Don't cast shadows from interface chrome; shadows belong to the food and to overlays.
Don't use photography or stock imagery; imagery is the procedural render set.
